title: scrophularia suffruticans
intro: Scrophularia suffruticans, commonly known as Alpine figwort or Alpine scrophularia, is a flowering plant species belonging to the figwort family (Scrophulariaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cognitive function, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Scrophularia suffruticans include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as phenolic acids, flavonoids, and iridoid glycosides. These bioactive compounds contribute to the plant's ability to protect against oxidative stress, infection, and cancer, while also promoting wound healing and tissue repair.
